# google_vertex_ai_training_pipeline

The TrainingPipeline orchestrates tasks associated with training a Model.


To get more information about TrainingPipeline, see:

* [API documentation](https://docs.cloud.google.com/gemini-enterprise-agent-platform/reference/rest/v1/projects.locations.trainingPipelines)
* How-to Guides
    * [Custom training overview](https://cloud.google.com/vertex-ai/docs/training/custom-training)

## Example Usage - Vertex Ai Training Pipeline Basic


```hcl
resource "google_vertex_ai_training_pipeline" "basic_pipeline" {
  display_name             = "test-training-pipeline"
  model_id                 = "test-model-id"
  region                   = "us-central1"
  training_task_definition = "gs://google-cloud-aiplatform/schema/trainingjob/definition/custom_task_1.0.0.yaml"

  training_task_inputs = jsonencode({
    workerPoolSpecs = [
      {
        machineSpec = {
          machineType = "n1-standard-4"
        }
        replicaCount = "1"
        diskSpec = {
          bootDiskType   = "pd-ssd"
          bootDiskSizeGb = 100
        }
        containerSpec = {
          imageUri = "gcr.io/cloud-marketplace/google/debian11"
        }
      }
    ]
  })

  labels = {
    env = "test"
  }
}
```

## Example Usage - Vertex Ai Training Pipeline Model


```hcl
resource "google_vertex_ai_training_pipeline" "model_pipeline" {
  display_name             = "test-training-pipeline-model"
  region                   = "us-central1"
  training_task_definition = "gs://google-cloud-aiplatform/schema/trainingjob/definition/custom_task_1.0.0.yaml"

  training_task_inputs = jsonencode({
    workerPoolSpecs = [
      {
        machineSpec = {
          machineType = "n1-standard-4"
        }
        replicaCount = "1"
        diskSpec = {
          bootDiskType   = "pd-ssd"
          bootDiskSizeGb = 100
        }
        containerSpec = {
          imageUri = "gcr.io/cloud-marketplace/google/debian11"
        }
      }
    ]
  })

  model_to_upload {
    display_name        = "test-model"
    description         = "A custom model uploaded from training pipeline"
    version_description = "v1 initial release"
    version_aliases     = ["v1", "latest"]
    artifact_uri        = "gs://${google_storage_bucket.bucket.name}/model"

    container_spec {
      image_uri     = "us-docker.pkg.dev/vertex-ai/prediction/tf2-cpu.2-8:latest"
      command       = ["python"]
      args          = ["-m", "server"]
      predict_route = "/predict"
      health_route  = "/health"

      env {
        name  = "APP_ENV"
        value = "production"
      }

      ports {
        container_port = 8080
      }

      grpc_ports {
        container_port = 8081
      }

      deployment_timeout     = "1800s"
      shared_memory_size_mb  = "128"

      startup_probe {
        exec {
          command = ["cat", "/tmp/ready"]
        }
        period_seconds  = 10
        timeout_seconds = 10
      }

      health_probe {
        exec {
          command = ["cat", "/tmp/healthy"]
        }
        period_seconds  = 10
        timeout_seconds = 10
      }
    }

    labels = {
      model_type = "custom"
    }

    explanation_spec {
      parameters = jsonencode({
        sampledShapleyAttribution = {
          pathCount = 5
        }
      })
      metadata = jsonencode({
        inputs = {
          features = {}
        }
        outputs = {
          predictions = {}
        }
      })
    }
  }

  model_id = "test-model-id"
  parent_model = "test-parent-model"

  labels = {
    env = "test"
  }
}

resource "google_storage_bucket" "bucket" {
  name                        = "test-model-bucket"
  location                    = "us-central1"
  force_destroy               = true
  uniform_bucket_level_access = true
}
```

## Example Usage - Vertex Ai Training Pipeline Dataset


```hcl
resource "google_vertex_ai_training_pipeline" "dataset_pipeline" {
  display_name             = "test-training-pipeline-dataset"
  model_id                 = "test-model-id"
  region                   = "us-central1"
  training_task_definition = "gs://google-cloud-aiplatform/schema/trainingjob/definition/custom_task_1.0.0.yaml"

  training_task_inputs = jsonencode({
    workerPoolSpecs = [
      {
        machineSpec = {
          machineType = "n1-standard-4"
        }
        replicaCount = "1"
        diskSpec = {
          bootDiskType   = "pd-ssd"
          bootDiskSizeGb = 100
        }
        containerSpec = {
          imageUri = "gcr.io/cloud-marketplace/google/debian11"
        }
      }
    ]
  })

  input_data_config {
    dataset_id             = google_vertex_ai_dataset.dataset.name
    annotation_schema_uri  = "gs://google-cloud-aiplatform/schema/dataset/annotation/image_classification_1.0.0.yaml"
    annotations_filter     = "annotation_filter_key:annotation_filter_value"
    persist_ml_use_assignment = false

    filter_split {
      training_filter   = "labels.test:training"
      validation_filter = "labels.test:validation"
      test_filter       = "labels.test:test"
    }

    gcs_destination {
      output_uri_prefix = "gs://${google_storage_bucket.bucket.name}/dataset-export"
    }
  }

  labels = {
    env = "test"
  }
}

resource "google_vertex_ai_dataset" "dataset" {
  display_name        = "test-dataset"
  metadata_schema_uri = "gs://google-cloud-aiplatform/schema/dataset/metadata/image_1.0.0.yaml"
  region              = "us-central1"
}

resource "google_storage_bucket" "bucket" {
  name                        = "test-bucket"
  location                    = "us-central1"
  force_destroy               = true
  uniform_bucket_level_access = true
}
```

## Argument Reference

The following arguments are supported:


* `display_name` -
  (Required)
  The user-defined name of this TrainingPipeline.

* `training_task_definition` -
  (Required)
  A Google Cloud Storage path to the YAML file that defines the training task which is responsible for producing the model artifact, and may also include additional auxiliary work. The definition files that can be used here are found in gs://google-cloud-aiplatform/schema/trainingjob/definition/.

* `training_task_inputs` -
  (Required)
  The training task's parameter(s), as specified in the training_task_definition's inputs. This field uses JSON data as a string.

* `model_id` -
  (Required)
  The ID to use for the uploaded Model, which will become the final component of the model resource name.


* `input_data_config` -
  (Optional)
  Specifies Vertex AI owned input data that may be used for training the Model.
  Structure is [documented below](#nested_input_data_config).

* `model_to_upload` -
  (Optional)
  Describes the Model that may be uploaded by this TrainingPipeline.
  Structure is [documented below](#nested_model_to_upload).

* `parent_model` -
  (Optional)
  When specified, the model_to_upload will become a new version of this parent_model.

* `encryption_spec` -
  (Optional)
  Customer-managed encryption key spec for a TrainingPipeline.
  Structure is [documented below](#nested_encryption_spec).

* `labels` -
  (Optional)
  The labels with user-defined metadata to organize TrainingPipelines.

  **Note**: This field is non-authoritative, and will only manage the labels present in your configuration.
  Please refer to the field `effective_labels` for all of the labels present on the resource.

* `region` -
  (Optional)
  The region of the training pipeline. eg us-central1

* `project` - (Optional) The ID of the project in which the resource belongs.
    If it is not provided, the provider project is used.

* `deletion_policy` - (Optional) Whether Terraform will be prevented from destroying the resource. Defaults to DELETE.
	When a 'terraform destroy' or 'terraform apply' would delete the resource,
	the command will fail if this field is set to "PREVENT" in Terraform state.
	When set to "ABANDON", the command will remove the resource from Terraform
	management without updating or deleting the resource in the API.
	When set to "DELETE", deleting the resource is allowed.


<a name="nested_input_data_config"></a>The `input_data_config` block supports:

* `dataset_id` -
  (Required)
  The ID of the Dataset in the same Project and Location which data will be used to train the Model.

* `annotations_filter` -
  (Optional)
  Applicable only to Datasets that have DataItems and Annotations. A filter on Annotations of the Dataset.

* `annotation_schema_uri` -
  (Optional)
  Applicable only to custom training with Datasets that have DataItems and Annotations. Cloud Storage URI that points to a YAML file describing the annotation schema.

* `saved_query_id` -
  (Optional)
  Only applicable to Datasets that have SavedQueries. The ID of a SavedQuery under the Dataset specified by dataset_id used for filtering Annotations for training.

* `persist_ml_use_assignment` -
  (Optional)
  Whether to persist the ML use assignment to data item system labels.

* `fraction_split` -
  (Optional)
  The instructions how the input data should be split between the training, validation and test sets.
  Structure is [documented below](#nested_input_data_config_fraction_split).

* `filter_split` -
  (Optional)
  Assigns input data to training, validation, and test sets based on the given filters.
  Structure is [documented below](#nested_input_data_config_filter_split).

* `predefined_split` -
  (Optional)
  Assigns input data to training, validation, and test sets based on the value of a provided key. Supported only for tabular Datasets.
  Structure is [documented below](#nested_input_data_config_predefined_split).

* `timestamp_split` -
  (Optional)
  Assigns input data to training, validation, and test sets based on provided timestamps. Supported only for tabular Datasets.
  Structure is [documented below](#nested_input_data_config_timestamp_split).

* `stratified_split` -
  (Optional)
  Assigns input data to the training, validation, and test sets so that the distribution of values found in the categorical column is mirrored within each split. Supported only for tabular Datasets.
  Structure is [documented below](#nested_input_data_config_stratified_split).

* `gcs_destination` -
  (Optional)
  The Cloud Storage location where the training data is to be written to.
  Structure is [documented below](#nested_input_data_config_gcs_destination).

* `bigquery_destination` -
  (Optional)
  The BigQuery location where the training data is to be written to.
  Structure is [documented below](#nested_input_data_config_bigquery_destination).


<a name="nested_input_data_config_fraction_split"></a>The `fraction_split` block supports:

* `training_fraction` -
  (Optional)
  The fraction of the input data that is to be used to train the Model.

* `validation_fraction` -
  (Optional)
  The fraction of the input data that is to be used to validate the Model.

* `test_fraction` -
  (Optional)
  The fraction of the input data that is to be used to evaluate the Model.

<a name="nested_input_data_config_filter_split"></a>The `filter_split` block supports:

* `training_filter` -
  (Required)
  A filter on DataItems of the Dataset for training set.

* `validation_filter` -
  (Required)
  A filter on DataItems of the Dataset for validation set.

* `test_filter` -
  (Required)
  A filter on DataItems of the Dataset for test set.

<a name="nested_input_data_config_predefined_split"></a>The `predefined_split` block supports:

* `key` -
  (Required)
  The key is a name of one of the Dataset's data columns.

<a name="nested_input_data_config_timestamp_split"></a>The `timestamp_split` block supports:

* `key` -
  (Required)
  The key is a name of one of the Dataset's data columns.

* `training_fraction` -
  (Optional)
  The fraction of the input data that is to be used to train the Model.

* `validation_fraction` -
  (Optional)
  The fraction of the input data that is to be used to validate the Model.

* `test_fraction` -
  (Optional)
  The fraction of the input data that is to be used to evaluate the Model.

<a name="nested_input_data_config_stratified_split"></a>The `stratified_split` block supports:

* `key` -
  (Required)
  The key is a name of one of the Dataset's data columns.

* `training_fraction` -
  (Optional)
  The fraction of the input data that is to be used to train the Model.

* `validation_fraction` -
  (Optional)
  The fraction of the input data that is to be used to validate the Model.

* `test_fraction` -
  (Optional)
  The fraction of the input data that is to be used to evaluate the Model.

<a name="nested_input_data_config_gcs_destination"></a>The `gcs_destination` block supports:

* `output_uri_prefix` -
  (Required)
  The Cloud Storage URI prefix to write to.

<a name="nested_input_data_config_bigquery_destination"></a>The `bigquery_destination` block supports:

* `output_uri` -
  (Required)
  The BigQuery table to which the output is to be written.

<a name="nested_model_to_upload"></a>The `model_to_upload` block supports:

* `name` -
  (Output)
  The resource name of the Model.

* `display_name` -
  (Required)
  The user-defined name of the Model.

* `description` -
  (Optional)
  The description of the Model.

* `version_description` -
  (Optional)
  The description of this version.

* `version_aliases` -
  (Optional)
  User provided version aliases so that a model version can be referenced using alias.

* `artifact_uri` -
  (Optional)
  The path to the directory containing the Model artifact and any of its supporting files.

* `container_spec` -
  (Optional)
  The specification of the container that is to be used when deploying this Model.
  Structure is [documented below](#nested_model_to_upload_container_spec).

* `labels` -
  (Optional)
  The labels with user-defined metadata to organize your Models.

* `encryption_spec` -
  (Optional)
  Customer-managed encryption key spec for a Model.
  Structure is [documented below](#nested_model_to_upload_encryption_spec).

* `explanation_spec` -
  (Optional)
  Specification of Model explanation.
  Structure is [documented below](#nested_model_to_upload_explanation_spec).


<a name="nested_model_to_upload_container_spec"></a>The `container_spec` block supports:

* `image_uri` -
  (Required)
  URI of the Docker image to be used as the custom container for serving predictions.

* `command` -
  (Optional)
  Specifies the command that runs when the container starts.

* `args` -
  (Optional)
  Specifies the arguments to the command when the container starts.

* `predict_route` -
  (Optional)
  HTTP path on the container to send prediction requests to.

* `health_route` -
  (Optional)
  HTTP path on the container to send health checks to.

* `env` -
  (Optional)
  List of environment variables to be set in the container.
  Structure is [documented below](#nested_model_to_upload_container_spec_env).

* `ports` -
  (Optional)
  List of ports that are exposed by the container's process.
  Structure is [documented below](#nested_model_to_upload_container_spec_ports).

* `grpc_ports` -
  (Optional)
  List of ports to expose from the container for gRPC.
  Structure is [documented below](#nested_model_to_upload_container_spec_grpc_ports).

* `deployment_timeout` -
  (Optional)
  Deployment timeout. Limit for deployment timeout is 2 hours.

* `shared_memory_size_mb` -
  (Optional)
  The amount of the VM memory to reserve as the shared memory for the model in megabytes.

* `startup_probe` -
  (Optional)
  Specification for Kubernetes startup probe.
  Structure is [documented below](#nested_model_to_upload_container_spec_startup_probe).

* `health_probe` -
  (Optional)
  Specification for Kubernetes readiness probe.
  Structure is [documented below](#nested_model_to_upload_container_spec_health_probe).


<a name="nested_model_to_upload_container_spec_env"></a>The `env` block supports:

* `name` -
  (Required)
  The name of the environment variable.

* `value` -
  (Required)
  The value of the environment variable.

<a name="nested_model_to_upload_container_spec_ports"></a>The `ports` block supports:

* `container_port` -
  (Required)
  The number of the port on the container.

<a name="nested_model_to_upload_container_spec_grpc_ports"></a>The `grpc_ports` block supports:

* `container_port` -
  (Required)
  The number of the port on the container.

<a name="nested_model_to_upload_container_spec_startup_probe"></a>The `startup_probe` block supports:

* `exec` -
  (Optional)
  ExecAction specifies a command to execute.
  Structure is [documented below](#nested_model_to_upload_container_spec_startup_probe_exec).

* `period_seconds` -
  (Optional)
  How often (in seconds) to perform the probe.

* `timeout_seconds` -
  (Optional)
  Number of seconds after which the probe times out.


<a name="nested_model_to_upload_container_spec_startup_probe_exec"></a>The `exec` block supports:

* `command` -
  (Optional)
  Command is the command line to execute inside the container.

<a name="nested_model_to_upload_container_spec_health_probe"></a>The `health_probe` block supports:

* `exec` -
  (Optional)
  ExecAction specifies a command to execute.
  Structure is [documented below](#nested_model_to_upload_container_spec_health_probe_exec).

* `period_seconds` -
  (Optional)
  How often (in seconds) to perform the probe.

* `timeout_seconds` -
  (Optional)
  Number of seconds after which the probe times out.


<a name="nested_model_to_upload_container_spec_health_probe_exec"></a>The `exec` block supports:

* `command` -
  (Optional)
  Command is the command line to execute inside the container.

<a name="nested_model_to_upload_encryption_spec"></a>The `encryption_spec` block supports:

* `kms_key_name` -
  (Required)
  The Cloud KMS resource identifier of the customer-managed encryption key used to protect the model.

<a name="nested_model_to_upload_explanation_spec"></a>The `explanation_spec` block supports:

* `parameters` -
  (Optional)
  Parameters that configure explaining of the Model's predictions. This field uses JSON data as a string.

* `metadata` -
  (Optional)
  Metadata describing the Model's input and output for explanation. This field uses JSON data as a string.

<a name="nested_encryption_spec"></a>The `encryption_spec` block supports:

* `kms_key_name` -
  (Required)
  The Cloud KMS resource identifier of the customer-managed encryption key used to protect the training pipeline.

## Attributes Reference

In addition to the arguments listed above, the following computed attributes are exported:

* `id` - an identifier for the resource with format `projects/{{project}}/locations/{{region}}/trainingPipelines/{{name}}`

* `name` -
  The resource name of the TrainingPipeline.

* `state` -
  The detailed state of the pipeline.

* `error` -
  Only populated when the pipeline's state is PIPELINE_STATE_FAILED or PIPELINE_STATE_CANCELLED.
  Structure is [documented below](#nested_error).

* `create_time` -
  Time when the TrainingPipeline was created.

* `start_time` -
  Time when the TrainingPipeline for the first time entered the PIPELINE_STATE_RUNNING state.

* `end_time` -
  Time when the TrainingPipeline entered any of the following states: PIPELINE_STATE_SUCCEEDED, PIPELINE_STATE_FAILED, PIPELINE_STATE_CANCELLED.

* `update_time` -
  Time when the TrainingPipeline was most recently updated.

* `training_task_metadata` -
  The metadata information as specified in the training_task_definition's metadata.

* `terraform_labels` -
  The combination of labels configured directly on the resource
   and default labels configured on the provider.

* `effective_labels` -
  All of labels (key/value pairs) present on the resource in GCP, including the labels configured through Terraform, other clients and services.


<a name="nested_error"></a>The `error` block contains:

* `code` -
  (Output)
  The status code, which should be an enum value of google.rpc.Code.

* `message` -
  (Output)
  A developer-facing error message.

## Timeouts

This resource provides the following
[Timeouts](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/plugin/sdkv2/resources/retries-and-customizable-timeouts) configuration options:

- `create` - Default is 30 minutes.
- `update` - Default is 0 minutes.
- `delete` - Default is 30 minutes.

## Import


TrainingPipeline can be imported using any of these accepted formats:

* `projects/{{project}}/locations/{{region}}/trainingPipelines/{{name}}`
* `{{project}}/{{region}}/{{name}}`
* `{{region}}/{{name}}`
* `{{name}}`

In Terraform v1.12.0 and later, use an [`identity` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/block/import#identity) to import TrainingPipeline using identity values. For example:

```tf
import {
  identity = {
    name = "<-optional value->"
    region = "<-optional value->"
    project = "<-optional value->"
  }
  to = google_vertex_ai_training_pipeline.default
}
```

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, use an [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) to import TrainingPipeline using one of the formats above. For example:

```tf
import {
  id = "projects/{{project}}/locations/{{region}}/trainingPipelines/{{name}}"
  to = google_vertex_ai_training_pipeline.default
}
```

When using the [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import), TrainingPipeline can be imported using one of the formats above. For example:

```
$ terraform import google_vertex_ai_training_pipeline.default projects/{{project}}/locations/{{region}}/trainingPipelines/{{name}}
$ terraform import google_vertex_ai_training_pipeline.default {{project}}/{{region}}/{{name}}
$ terraform import google_vertex_ai_training_pipeline.default {{region}}/{{name}}
$ terraform import google_vertex_ai_training_pipeline.default {{name}}
```

## User Project Overrides

This resource supports [User Project Overrides](https://registry.terraform.io/providers/hashicorp/google/latest/docs/guides/provider_reference#user_project_override).
